args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api deploy v2.3.1 failed health checks in production (observed error rate ~0.18). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production, across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). First rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving regions on mixed versions; retry completed the rollout to v2.3.0 in all regions. Service is now healthy (error rate ~0.002). Follow-up: root-cause the orchestrator partial failure and the regression in v2.3.1 before attempting to redeploy it.

Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: The latest deploy, v2.3.1, was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy release.
2. **Rolled back**: Initiated a rollback to v2.3.0. The first attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error, leaving regions mixed on v2.3.0/v2.3.1). A retry completed the rollback to v2.3.0 in all regions.
3. **Verified**: checkout-api is now healthy across us-east, us-west, and eu-west, with error rate down from ~0.18 to ~0.002.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident**: INC-0001, documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback (including the initial partial failure), the healthy state after rollback, and follow-up items (root-cause the orchestrator error and the v2.3.1 regression before redeploying it).
